description: Get one activity of the Algerian ANAE nomenclature (auto-entrepreneur status) by its six-digit code, for example 010101: its labels in French, Arabic and English and its domain. Use it when the user gives a code, or after search_anae_activities. Returns an error when the code does not exist. In Algeria an activity that has a regime of its own carries the optional object regime, present only then and today only for 080101, micro-importation: note (the facts in French, Arabic and English: who may import, at most 1,800,000 DZD of goods per trip and two trips a month, the card and the general authorisation of the Ministry of Foreign Trade, the conditions, the advantages, the obligations, the exclusions), legal_reference (executive decree n° 25-170 of 28 June 2025, JO n° 40 of 2025) and source_url (the Journal Officiel PDF). That activity is NOT governed by the ordinary auto-entrepreneur limits: never present the 5 million DZD yearly turnover ceiling of the ordinary status as its limit, and read regime.note before answering about it. For Tunisia (country TN) pass the key regime: you get who qualifies (Tunisian nationality, individual practice, the sectors, the ceiling of 75,000 dinars of yearly turnover), the exclusions, the duration, the registration, the single contribution with what it replaces and what it is made of, the late payment fine and the deregistration, each with the article of the law it comes from. The official list of activities is not loaded: say so, and never present the absence of an activity as an exclusion. For Morocco (country MA) pass the key of an excluded profession (for example avocats) to get it with the regime, or the key regime to get the regime alone: the definition, the turnover ceilings (500 000 and 200 000 dirhams), the tax rates (0.5 % and 1 %), the obligations and the legal texts (law 114-13 and its decrees).

code.description: ANAE activity code, six digits, for example 010101. For Morocco (country MA) it is the key of an excluded profession, for example avocats, or regime. Find codes with search_anae_activities. For Tunisia (country TN) it is the key of the regime record: regime (statut and ae are accepted too); Tunisia has no activity codes.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

name: get_anae_activity
title: Get an ANAE activity
